client_scheduling_fix.cause: Full /proc identity scans after every ROS callback cost a median 19.85 ms on the Pi, starving callbacks and causing command expiry and observation RPC timeouts.
client_scheduling_fix.fix: Run the full identity scan initially and then at a 0.2 s cadence. Initial/final identity checks, freshness rules and stop behavior are retained; the native release is unchanged.
client_scheduling_fix.verification: 167 implementation tests; 73 focused root/reviewer tests. A read-only Pi 200 Hz timer probe improved from 91 to 369 callbacks over 2 s with bounded scans. Persistent-runner validation is recorded separately.

client_scheduling_fix.scope: Scan cadence plus callback and scan time; not a hard 0.2 s identity-detection deadline.
